description_en: Retrieves a list of historical running instances for a real-time task. Available since v6.4.0
description_zh: 获取实时任务历史运行实例列表，上线版本：v6.4.0
name: ListStreamInstanceRecords

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Dataphin project to which the task belongs. This parameter is used for permission verification in the production environment
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属的Dataphin项目ID，用于生产环境权限校验
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task file. Set this parameter to the fileId value returned by the GetStreamTask operation. The value must be a positive integer
parameters.help_zh: 任务文件ID，取GetStreamTask返回的fileId，需为正整数格式
parameters.name: file_id

Data.description_en: The historical running instance records of the real-time task. You can use the deploymentInstanceId to query the logs of a specific run
Data.description_zh: 实时任务的一次历史运行实例记录，deploymentInstanceId 可用于查询该次运行的日志

items.description_en: The historical running instance records of the real-time task. You can use the deploymentInstanceId to query the logs of a specific run
items.description_zh: 实时任务的一次历史运行实例记录，deploymentInstanceId 可用于查询该次运行的日志

DeploymentId.description_en: The deployment ID of the task. A single deployment can be associated with multiple running instances
DeploymentId.description_zh: 任务的部署ID，同一部署可关联多次运行实例

DeploymentInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the deployment running instance. This value corresponds to the DeploymentInstanceId request parameter in the log and TaskManager query operations
DeploymentInstanceId.description_zh: 部署运行实例ID，对应日志和TaskManager查询接口的 DeploymentInstanceId 入参

ErrorDataPath.description_en: The relative path for dirty data storage in this run, excluding the storage service domain name. A value of null indicates that no dirty data path exists
ErrorDataPath.description_zh: 本次运行的脏数据存储相对路径，不带存储服务域名；null表示没有脏数据路径
ErrorDataPath.title_en: 本次运行的脏数据存储相对路径
ErrorDataPath.title_zh: 本次运行的脏数据存储相对路径

StartTime.description_en: The start time of this run. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
StartTime.description_zh: 本次运行的开始时间，格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

State.description_en: The running instance status returned by the engine, such as RUNNING, FINISHED, and TRANSITIONING. This status uses a different enumeration from the TaskStatusEnum returned by the GetStreamTask operation
State.description_zh: 引擎返回的运行实例状态，如 RUNNING运行中、FINISHED已完成、TRANSITIONING状态切换中；与 GetStreamTask 返回的 TaskStatusEnum 状态不是同一套枚举
State.title_en: 引擎返回的运行实例状态
State.title_zh: 引擎返回的运行实例状态

items.title_en: 获取实时任务历史运行实例列表
items.title_zh: 获取实时任务历史运行实例列表

Data.title_en: 获取实时任务历史运行实例列表
Data.title_zh: 获取实时任务历史运行实例列表
